scope: local warp representation, conservative bounds, lifetime/memory and oracle parity for the unpublished forward-drizzle-v2 dense-scatter kernel. Library-level; not wired into the production runner.

rejected.reason: all frame grids persistent: device memory grows with N, violates the frozen bounded-memory contract
grid rebuilt per band: redundant full-source inversion sweeps per band, multiplies the most expensive local-warp work by band_count
disk/mmap-backed per-frame grid with bounded GPU residency: bounded but adds I/O amplification, a second persistence format and eviction complexity for no benefit over 140 bytes of coefficients

representation_decision.model: the existing SmoothLocalWarpModel (4x4 normalized Gaussian basis, sigma 0.28, 8 percent boundary smoothstep taper, coeff_x/coeff_y 16 floats each, image dims, model_coordinate_scale + offset) IS already the compact representation: ~144 bytes per frame, 600 frames fit in ~86 KiB host side; the device consumes the descriptor through kernel parameters and performs the bounded fixed-point inversion on device. No grid memory is allocated anywhere.
representation_decision.cpu_oracle_contract: subdivide_local + invert_local_source_to_canvas + evaluate_smooth_local_displacement + smooth_local_basis in the existing production code are the frozen oracle; the device port must reproduce identical acceptance/discard decisions on the frozen matrix

inversion_contract.fixed_point: q_0 = u = affine(s); q_{n+1} = u - d(q_n) in render units; q_model = (q_render - offset) * scale; d_render = d_model / scale
fail_closed: iterate leaves the canvas by more than safety_margin_px
invalid model (valid flag false, non-positive scale, non-finite coefficient)
inversion_contract.arithmetic: inversion internals in fp32 exactly like the CPU oracle (expf basis); geometry, error norms and areas in fp64 like the CPU oracle

subdivision_contract.grid: 3x3 inversions per node; parent quad = corner points (0,0),(0,2),(2,2),(2,0)
subdivision_contract.acceptance: area > 0 AND bilinear position error <= position_epsilon_internal_px (0.05) AND |child_area - area| / area <= area_relative_epsilon (0.005)
subdivision_contract.all_or_nothing: ANY inversion failure or ANY node rejected at max depth discards the ENTIRE source sample including already accepted leaves - mirrors leaves.resize(before); return false in the CPU oracle
subdivision_contract.node_enumeration: implicit 21-node tree (1 + 4 + 16); accepted-node bitmask u32; leaf corners re-evaluated at emit time, no per-thread leaf buffer

conservative_bounds.displacement_bound: |d(q)| <= max_i ||(coeff_x[i], coeff_y[i])|| because the normalized basis weights are non-negative and sum to the taper <= 1; proven in the spec and verified on a dense evaluation grid in tests
conservative_bounds.candidate_box: the per-leaf bbox is EXACT (corner min/max), not a conservative estimate - same contract as the affine scatter
conservative_bounds.non_invertible_regions: fail closed per sample; per-frame discard counts are reported to the host which applies the per_frame_inversion_error_rate_max exclusion policy at driver level
conservative_bounds.memory_bound: zero additional device residency per frame: the warp descriptor travels in kernel launch parameters; per-frame bytes unchanged from the affine path

oracle_cases.name: zero_coefficients_affine_parity
oracle_cases.expect: bit-level decisions and areas equal the affine scatter

oracle_cases.name: mild_single_bump
oracle_cases.expect: depth 0-1 acceptance; planes match leaf-replay oracle

oracle_cases.name: strong_curvature_depth2
oracle_cases.expect: forces depth-2 nodes; planes match oracle; decision parity

oracle_cases.name: boundary_taper
oracle_cases.expect: displacement vanishes inside the 8 percent taper; planes match oracle

oracle_cases.name: non_invertible_region
oracle_cases.expect: affected samples discarded all-or-nothing; discarded count reported; no partial contribution

oracle_cases.name: invalid_model
oracle_cases.expect: every sample discarded; frame contributes nothing

oracle_cases.name: translated_affine_seed
oracle_cases.expect: real M42 affine seed + mild model; planes match oracle

oracle_cases.name: osc_and_mono
oracle_cases.expect: CFA channel mapping unchanged by local geometry

oracle_cases.name: multi_frame_stream
oracle_cases.expect: local frames interleaved with affine frames accumulate into the same band workspace with unchanged fold/finalize semantics

performance_gate.note: same per-frame bound as gate 1 applies to the local prototype on the production band geometry; measured separately for a worst-case depth-forcing model and a realistic mild model
performance_gate.memory_gate: device_bytes_per_native_pixel unchanged; reserved_device_bytes unchanged except the kernel-parameter descriptor

real_data_note: no production run contains smooth local models (m42: local_model_samples_total=0, p90_below_trigger). The gate-8 matrix therefore pairs REAL M42 affine seeds and canvas geometry with synthetic models of realistic magnitude (displacements of a few px, matching what the >0.55px p90 trigger produces). A fresh real local 600-frame production run remains gate-10 scope and is NOT claimed here.
out_of_scope: preflight coverage bounds using the displacement bound (gate 9/10 driver)
frame exclusion policy enforcement (driver consumes the reported discard count)
